g.text: tools to provide users with greater
This map outlines the key stakeholders and their roles in interventions aimed at
promoting the mental well-being of social media users. It emphasizes the
collaborative efforts needed across sectors to tackle the multifaceted challenges
posed by social media. Proposed interventions include enacting legislation to
enhance content moderation, strengthen data protection, and support mental
health through partnerships with researchers and organizations. Platforms should
embrace ethical design principles, foster positive feedback loops, and develop tools
that support self-regulation and privacy. Raising awareness and incorporating
digital citizenship, media literacy, and mindful usage into education can empower
users and cultivate a more positive digital landscape.
